name: 0.5 - Acts I-IV and Interludes 1-3
note: The guide pack for the Campaign Helper (2.77.0). Hand-written: each step's 'do', the tips, the rewards and the vendor searches. Zones the game adds are learned from players' logs (Community data sharing) and added by tools/build_guide.py. 'side': a detour off the story path (left out of the Speedrun route). 'speed' (2.89.0): the Speedrun guide - skip: left out; do: its own instruction. A reward with "speed": true is still taken in a speedrun (the rest aren't asked about). 'optional': shown only with Show optional zones. 'proof': zones whose entry proves a reward was taken. 'rush' (2.125.0): the Rush (carry) guide, from the carrier's side - skip / do as 'speed'; the order and essentials follow poe2wiki.net's Guide:Acts quick guide.

acts.name: Act I

rush.do: Kill the Bloated Miller with them in the zone, then lead the way to town.

steps.do: Town - talk to Renly and Una

rush.do: Wait while they talk to Renly and Una, then lead on to Clearfell.

steps.do: Kill Beira of the Rotten Pack

speed.do: Kill Beira (+10% cold res), then head to the Grelwood. Skip the Mud Burrow.

rush.do: Clear to Beira and bring them in for the kill (their +10% cold res), then on to the Grelwood.

steps.do: Light the Witch Hut cauldron (free flask), then on to the Red Vale

speed.do: Grab the waypoints and skip the Witch Hut. Come back later to place the Runed Spikes at the Tree of Souls.

rush.do: Have them tag the waypoint and summon Una. Clear to the Red Vale (opposite side). Later: they place the Runed Spikes at the 3 seals.

steps.do: Activate the obelisks, kill the Rust King

rush.do: Activate the 3 obelisks, kill the Rust King with them there. They pick up the 3 runed items, then portal to town.

speed.do: Run through to the Cemetery. Skip Ervig.

rush.do: Run them through to the Cemetery. Summon Una and Farrow and kill the boss if the quest needs it.

steps.do: Open the Tomb and the Mausoleum

speed.do: Open the Tomb and the Mausoleum. Skip the side ruins.

rush.do: Wait while they talk to Lachlann. Clear the Tomb and the Mausoleum with them, then kill Lachlann with them there.
Kill Asinia with them in the zone. They take Asinia's key piece.

steps.do: Kill Draven, then Lachlann in the Cemetery

speed.do: Kill Draven, then Lachlann in the Cemetery. Skip the hidden cache.

rush.do: Kill Draven with them in the zone. They take Draven's key piece, then back to the Cemetery for Lachlann.

speed.do: Kill the Crowbell (+2 points). Grab the Freythorn and Ogham Farmlands waypoints.

rush.do: Kill the Crowbell with them in the zone (their +2 points). They tag the Freythorn and Ogham Farmlands waypoints.

steps.do: Kill the King in the Mists

speed.do: Light the 3 small altars, kill the King in the Mists (+30 spirit). Skip the Ominous Altars.

rush.do: Clear the rituals, then kill the King in the Mists with them there (their +30 spirit). They talk to Finn.

speed.do: Grab Una's Lute (+2 points) and keep going.

rush.do: They tag the waypoint and take Una's Lute from the box before the farms (+2 points when they hand it in).

steps.do: Get Renly's Smithing Tools, kill the Executioner

speed.do: Kill the Executioner. Get the Smithing Tools only on your first character this league.

rush.do: Kill the Executioner with them there; they pull the lever and talk to Leitis. Their first character this league: they take the Smithing Tools for Renly.
They tag the waypoint and hand in at town (+2 points), then on to the Manor.
Kill Candlemass (their +20 life) and Count Geonor with them in the zone. They talk to the Hooded One in town.

acts.tip: Check the vendors for 15% movement speed boots from about level 16.

acts.name: Act II

speed.do: Skip the packs and go straight to Rathbreaker.

rush.do: Go straight to Rathbreaker and kill it with them there. They talk to Zarka.
Wait while they talk to the NPCs, then use the desert map.
Run them through to the Mine.
They tag the waypoint. Kill Rudja with them there; they open the cage and talk to Risu.

speed.do: Run up to the Halani Gates. Skip Balbala - you get a better Barya in Deshar.

rush.do: They tag the waypoint. Run up to the Halani Gates (skip Balbala - the Deshar Barya is better).
They tag the waypoint and summon Asala. Beat Jamanra, the Risen King with them there.

speed.do: Do it later, at about level 28, with the Barya from Deshar, right before The Dreadnought.

rush.do: Skip for now. A carry for all 8 ascendancy points: level 75+ Djinn Barya, 4 floors.
Run them to the Bone Pits (the Well of Souls is in the Lightless Passage in the middle).

steps.do: Kill Iktab and Ekbab - take the relic

speed.do: Kill hyenas until the Sun Clan Relic drops, then kill Iktab and Ekbab.

rush.do: They tag the waypoint. Kill hyenas until the Sun Clan Relic drops - they pick it up - then kill Iktab and Ekbab with them there.

speed.do: Kill snakes until the Kabala Clan Relic drops, then kill Kabala (+2 points).

rush.do: Kill snakes until the Kabala Clan Relic drops (they pick it up), then kill Kabala with them there (their +2 points).
Run them through to the Buried Shrines.

speed.do: Kill Azarian, take the Essence of Water. Skip the offering shrine and sarcophagus.

rush.do: Kill Azarian with them there. They talk to the Water Goddess and take the Essence of Water.

steps.do: Place both relics at the altar

rush.do: They tag the waypoint and pick the charm medallion. They place both relics at the altar.
Kill Zalmarath with them there. They take the Flame Ruby, then portal to town for the horn.

steps.do: Find the Final Letter, give it to Shambrin

speed.do: Take the Final Letter (+2 points). Kill the Watchful Twins for the level 28 Barya.

rush.do: They take the Final Letter from Lailuma's body (+2 points). Kill the Watchful Twins with them there for the Djinn Barya.
Run them through to the Spires.

steps.do: Pray at the Sisters of Garukhan shrine, kill Tor Gul

rush.do: They tag the waypoint and pray at the Sisters of Garukhan shrine (+10% lightning res). Kill Tor Gul with them there.

speed.do: Kill Jamanra, the Abomination, here at about level 28.

rush.do: They tag the waypoint. Kill Jamanra, the Abomination with them in the zone.

acts.tip: Trial of the Sekhemas gives your first 2 ascendancy points. Look for 20% boots from about level 33.

acts.name: Act III

speed.do: Run to the town. Skip Rootdredge.

rush.do: Run them to the town. Skip Rootdredge.
Wait while they talk to the NPCs, then on to the Jungle Ruins.

speed.do: Kill Mighty Silverfist (+2 points). Skip the camps.

rush.do: Kill Mighty Silverfist with them there (their +2 points). Skip the camps.

steps.do: Take the Venom Vial to Servi (a choice you keep)

speed.do: Grab the venom and go back to town for Servi's choice. Skip the side events.

rush.do: Run to the corpse at the end; they take the Corpse-snake Venom and give it to Servi in town (their pick).

steps.do: On to the Azak Bog and the Wetlands

speed.do: Run through to the Chimeral Wetlands.

rush.do: They tag the waypoint. Run them to the Chimeral Wetlands.

speed.do: You reach it from the Matlan Waterways now. Kill Ignagduk (+30 spirit).

rush.do: They tag the waypoint and summon Servi. Kill Ignagduk with them there (their +30 spirit).

speed.do: Kill Xyclucian. Skip the camps.

rush.do: They tag the waypoint. Kill Xyclucian with them there; they take the Inscribed Ultimatum.
They tag the waypoint and summon Alva. Feed the soul cores, kill Blackjaw with them there (their +10% fire res).

steps.do: Kill Zicoatl, Warden of the Core

rush.do: They tag the waypoint. Start both generators, kill Zicoatl with them there; they take the Large Soul Core.
Step on every pressure plate and pull the big lever at the end, with them following.

steps.do: On to the Molten Vault and the Apex

speed.do: Run through to the Apex of Filth.

rush.do: They tag the waypoint and summon Oswald. Run them to the Apex of Filth.

speed.do: First character this league only: kill Mektul for the Reforging Bench. Skip it on later characters.

rush.do: Their first character this league only: kill Mektul with them there for the Reforging Bench.

speed.do: Kill the Queen of Filth. Skip the cauldron.

rush.do: They tag the waypoint. Kill the Queen of Filth with them there; they take the Temple Door Idol.

steps.do: Kill Ketzuli, High Priest of the Sun

rush.do: Kill Ketzuli with them there. They summon Alva and tag the waypoint behind the gateway.

speed.do: Follow the road to Viper Napuatzi. Kill Vaal Goliaths until the Sacrificial Heart drops.

rush.do: They tag the waypoint. Kill Viper Napuatzi, then Vaal Goliaths until the Sacrificial Heart drops (they pick it up).

steps.do: Offer the Sacrificial Heart at the altar

rush.do: They tag the waypoint, take the dagger and offer the heart at the altar (+2 points).
They tag the waypoint. Kill Doryani with them there; they talk to Doryani.

acts.tip: Trial of Chaos gives 2 more ascendancy points.

acts.name: Act IV

rush.do: Wait while they talk to the NPCs and Makoru, then sail.

speed.do: Run to the Volcanic Warrens. Skip the Primal Arena.

rush.do: They click the Flayed Sailor on the shore for the map piece. Run to the Volcanic Warrens.

speed.do: Kill Krutog. Skip the Volcanic Nest.

rush.do: Kill Krutog with them there. They talk to the Hooded One.
They pass the 3 tests at the Well of Hinekora and pay their respects (+5% mana).

steps.do: Finish the three trials (a choice each)

rush.do: They tag the waypoint and pass the 3 tests (their picks). Beat Yama the White with them there; they take the Silver Coin.
They tag the waypoint, talk to Navali and take the Tattoo of Hinekora (+2 points).

steps.do: Kill the Scourge of the Skies

rush.do: They take the map piece from the corpse nest. Kill the Scourge of the Skies with them there.

speed.do: Run to the Singing Caverns. Skip the shark and the crab cave.

rush.do: They click the Petrified Pirate for the map piece. Kill the Great White One with them there (their defense pick).

speed.do: Kill Diamora. Skip the Humming Pearl.

rush.do: They tag the waypoint. Kill Diamora with them there.

speed.do: Find the way to Solitary Confinement. Do the Goddess of Justice only if the Chapel Key drops on the way.

rush.do: Kill for the Chapel Key, open the chapel; they tag the waypoint and use the Goddess of Justice (their pick).
Pull the levers, kill the Prisoner with them there.

speed.do: Follow the path to Journey's End. Skip the side areas.

rush.do: They open the Dead Man's Chest for the map piece. Run them to Journey's End.
Kill Captain Hartlin, then Omniphobia with them there (+2 points after they talk to Tujen).

speed.do: Skip the bells and go straight to the main objective.

rush.do: They tag the waypoint. Go straight to Torvian and kill him with them there.

speed.do: Run straight to the boss.

rush.do: Kill Benedictus with them there. They talk to the Hooded One.

steps.do: On to the Heart of the Tribe

speed.do: Run to the Heart of the Tribe. Skip the Mad Butcher.

rush.do: They talk to Kaimana for their boon. Run them to the Heart of the Tribe.
They tag the waypoint. Kill Tavakai (all three forms) with them there.

acts.tip: Aim for 25% boots by about level 46.

steps.do: Kill Akthi and Anundr, talk to Risu

speed.do: Kill Akthi and Anundr, talk to Risu. Use the Molten One's Gift (+5% life).

rush.do: Kill Akthi and Anundr with them there (+2 points from Risu). They take the Molten One's Gift (+5% life).

steps.do: Pick a boon at the Seven Pillars

speed.do: Pick a boon at the Seven Pillars (in a niche at the map edge). Do not pick the experience boon.

rush.do: They tag the waypoint and pick a Seven Pillars boon. Skip the experience boon.
They tag the waypoint. Kill Lythara with them there (their +40 spirit).
Kill the Abominable Yeti with them there; they take the Icy Tusks to Hilda (+2 points).

steps.do: Talk to Elder Madox - a free unique

rush.do: They tag the waypoint and take Elder Madox's gift.

acts.name: Interlude 3

rush.do: Kill Oswin with them there (their +2 points).
Run them to the Holten Estate.

acts.tip: Then talk to the Hooded One in Kingsmarch for 2 more points.

rewards.what: The Hooded One, after the Interludes
